title: Sierra Canyon Backpacker Trek
alt: Hikers walking along a rocky canyon trail surrounded by trees
summary: Guided trail pass, shared camp spot, and basic trail snacks for budget-conscious trekkers.
details: Includes certified trail guide, permit fees, emergency support, and camping pitch access. Bring your own sleeping bag or rent basic gear at check-in.

title: Clearwater Family Kayak Float
alt: Calm river water with green trees along the shoreline
summary: Calm-water paddling route ideal for families with older kids seeking affordable outdoor fun.
details: Includes kayak, paddle, life vest, safety briefing, and shuttle back to the launch point. Designed for beginners and families.

title: Pine Ridge Group Basecamp
alt: Pine forest clearing under clear daytime sky
summary: Group-friendly forest basecamp with daytime hikes, stargazing, and discounted group rates.
details: Tailored for friend groups, clubs, and student outings of six or more. Includes reserved group camp area, daytime guided hikes, and group logistics.
